key_risks: Business and competitive risk: intensifying competition in digital health and e-pharmacy could compress margins or slow customer and retailer acquisition.
Regulatory risk: changes in laws governing pharmacies, e-commerce of drugs, data protection and foreign investment could affect operating model.
Execution and integration risk: timely execution of warehousing capacity expansion, automation roll-out, and proposed corporate restructuring (SHBL merger and financial services demerger).
Liquidity and capital risk: continuing operating losses in certain segments necessitate continued access to capital on acceptable terms.
Technology and cybersecurity risk: reliance on digital platforms exposes risks around data security, system availability and cyber threats.
Concentration and counterparty risk: dependence on key suppliers, logistics partners and retail pharmacy relationships.
